stem: An engineer is preparing an automated image ingestion pipeline that sends user photos to the Azure Vision Read API for optical character recognition. What is the maximum allowed image file size supported by Azure Vision?
explanation: Azure Vision requires input images to have a file size of less than 4 MB. Supported image formats include JPEG, PNG, GIF, and BMP, with dimensions between 50 x 50 and 10,000 x 10,000 pixels for the Read API.

distractorNotes.b: Ten megabytes exceeds the 4 MB file size limit for direct image analysis in Azure Vision.
distractorNotes.c: Twenty megabytes exceeds the supported 4 MB limit for image payloads.
distractorNotes.d: Fifty megabytes is far above the 4 MB threshold supported by the image processing APIs.

sourceNote: Azure Vision input image requirements - maximum 4 MB file size
